Candidate CV:

YOUR_FULL_NAME
IT Support / Service Desk Specialist
Warsaw, Poland

PROFILE
Technical specialist with 12+ years of experience in the maritime sector, currently retraining for IT Support / Service Desk. Practical knowledge of Windows systems, computer networks (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), Active Directory, and hardware diagnostics — partly from professional work, partly from a home lab. Currently completing the Google IT Support Professional Certificate.

SKILLS
- Systems: Windows 10/11, Windows Server, MS Office, Microsoft 365
- Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN — configuration and diagnostics
- Active Directory: basic administration, GPO
- Virtualization: VMware, VirtualBox
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MariaDB — basics
- Scripting: Python, PowerShell, Bash
- Hardware: diagnostics, repair, assembly
- User support, technical documentation
- English B1/B2, Polish A2/B1

EXPERIENCE
Technical Systems Specialist | Maritime Sector | Your Years
- Maintained critical systems 24/7
- Diagnosed and repaired hardware and software issues
- Installed and configured Windows 10/11 workstations
- Configured and maintained computer networks (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN)
- Supported users with daily technical problems
- Maintained technical documentation in English
- Trained new crew members

PROJECTS (Home Lab)
Active Directory & Group Policy Lab
- Built a domain environment in VMware/VirtualBox
- Configured AD, user accounts, and groups
- Implemented GPOs

HomeLab Monitor | Python, psutil, Telegram API
- Built Python scripts for system monitoring
- Created automatic PDF report generator
- Integrated with Telegram Bot API

CERTIFICATES
- Google IT Support Professional Certificate — in progress

LANGUAGES
- Ukrainian, Russian — native
- Polish — A2/B1
- English — B1/B2

messageValues.message: You are an HR analyst. Compare a job description with a candidate's CV.  CRITICAL RULES: 1. Extract ONLY hard, technical skills (tools, systems, technologies, languages of programming). 2. NEVER include soft skills (like "communication", "teamwork", "willingness", "shifts"). 3. NEVER include job responsibilities as skills. 4. Match skills by MEANING, not exact wording. "Linux Debian" matches "Linux (Debian or Ubuntu)". 5. Only list skills that appear EXPLICITLY in the job description.  Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact format: {"job_title": "...", "company": "...", "matched_skills": ["..."], "missing_skills": ["..."]}  If company is not mentioned, write "Not specified". Return ONLY JSON, no explanations.

assignments.value: Junior IT Support Specialist  Company: TechSupport Solutions Location: Your city  We are looking for a Junior IT Support Specialist to join our team.  Requirements: - Basic knowledge of Windows 10/11 and Windows Server - Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN - Familiarity with Active Directory and Group Policy - Experience with hardware diagnostics and repair - Basic scripting skills (Python or PowerShell) - English at B1/B2 level - Willingness to work in shifts - Strong communication skills and documentation habits  Nice to have: - VMware or VirtualBox experience - Knowledge of Linux (Debian or Ubuntu) - Basic SQL knowledge - Docker fundamentals  Responsibilities: - Support end users with hardware and software issues - Configure and maintain workstations - Document technical procedures - Troubleshoot network connectivity problems - Collaborate with the IT team on infrastructure tasks
